name: aero-wind-sports-tracker
description: Track kitesurfing, wing foiling, windsurfing & hydrofoil sessions

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/icons && cp index.html styles.css app.js auth.js supabase-config.js sw.js manifest.json www/ && cp icons/* www/icons/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
